name: Copper Compression Socks (6 Pack)
seoTitle: Compression Socks for Nurses 6 Pack Gift
metaDescription: A six pack of copper compression socks for nurses who spend long shifts on their feet, a practical gift that covers a full work week of socks and more.
summary: A practical gift for nurses on their feet all day: six pairs of compression socks, enough to rotate through a full stretch of shifts.
bestFor: New grads building a work wardrobe
Nurses who walk miles per shift
whyItWorks: Walk onto almost any hospital floor and you will find nurses wearing compression socks under their scrubs. After three 12 hour shifts in a row, standing at bedsides and walking the length of the unit again and again, legs and feet feel it. Socks like these are one of those gifts nurses often buy for themselves, which is a good sign that they will actually be used.

Getting six pairs in one pack is the real appeal. Nurses go through socks quickly, and having enough to cover a full week of shifts plus laundry day means fewer frantic mornings digging through a drawer. For a new grad starting their first job, a stack of socks is an unglamorous but genuinely helpful present. For a seasoned nurse, it is a refill of something they already rely on. Pair the pack with a good foot cream or a gift card for a shoe store to round it out.
goodToKnow: Check the size chart on the listing carefully, since compression fit depends on shoe size and calf measurements.
Look at the listing for compression level and color options, which the title does not specify.
Anyone with circulation conditions should ask their own doctor before wearing compression garments.

faq.q: Will these work for a male nurse?
faq.a: The title lists them for both women and men. Just check the size chart so the fit matches their shoe size.

faq.q: Is a sock gift too boring for a nurse?
faq.a: Most nurses see good compression socks as a welcome, practical gift. Adding a fun card or a coffee gift card makes it feel more personal.
